title: Character Creation and Backstory
notes: Players created their character, provided backstories, and shared the story of the campaign.

title: The Vault
notes:
Mission Summary:
The central treasury of Rena—located beneath the Council Chambers—has been robbed. It wasn’t just a theft of coin. It was a demonstration of overwhelming power and precision:
	• The Shaded Sigil’s magical defenses were shredded, not bypassed—as if someone unspelled the spells from the inside out.
	• The Crimson Guard’s defenders were brutally executed, with no signs of alarm, struggle, or magical discharge. Many of their eyes and tongues were removed, a signature not tied to any known group.
	• The Golden Ledger’s vault protections—a combination of arcane puzzles, divine locks, and code-based puzzles—were solved or broken, in some cases with impossible accuracy.

Mission Objectives (from the Triumvirate):
	• Determine how the breach occurred.
	• Identify who did it—or who helped them.
	• Prevent panic by conducting the investigation in complete secrecy.
	• Return any stolen artifacts—particularly those of magical or political value.
	• Avoid implicating any one faction unless proof is absolute.

Initial Leads (provided after meeting):
	• A severed vault seal left behind, made from a metal that doesn't match any known alloy in Rena.
	• A single scrap of parchment, burnt around the edges, with a faded Velrathi numeral—likely referencing one of the old imperial dynasties.
	• Three survivors—non-combatant clerks—currently unconscious in a magically induced sleep, resistant to common healing spells or magical detection.
	• A strange residue left behind on the vault floor—detectable by Detect Magic or Arcana, but its aura doesn’t match any known school of magic.

Suggested Next Steps for Players:
	• Interview surviving aides or clerks (if/when they awaken).
	• Visit the vault site under supervision.
	• Investigate black market rumors about new influxes of treasure or relics.
	• Seek out any disenfranchised ex-faction agents who may have knowledge of vault layouts or countermeasures.
	• Research the Velrathi numeral for links to ruins, families, or secret orders.

Tone to Maintain:
	• Political tension: Each faction believes another may have orchestrated the robbery, but can’t prove it (yet).
	• Trust issues: Players are being forced to work together, but may be offered secret side deals or bribes by their own faction leaders.
	• Paranoia and silence: The city must not know. Rumors are dangerous, and the public is already restless.
	• Power beneath the surface: This was no ordinary heist—it was an act of power rooted in something far older than the three factions.
